text: A股沪深京三市成交额再度突破2万亿元，较昨日此时放量1076亿元，连续2个交易日成交量在2万亿元以上。
text_en: Turnover across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing A-share markets once again exceeded RMB 2 trillion, up RMB 107.6 billion from the same time yesterday, marking the second consecutive trading day with turnover above RMB 2 trillion.
